claim_scope.cohort_reuse: The 80-participant-cluster cohort was used in the source Job C-R depth-profile analysis. This is a prespecified follow-up on reused data, not an independent confirmation cohort.

decision_rule.multiplicity: Holm adjustment over four one-sided model-by-mechanism bootstrap p-values
decision_rule.positive_cell: Holm-adjusted one-sided p < 0.05 against delta rho <= 0 and point estimate >= 0.10 rho units. The 0.10 condition is a point-estimate screen, not a test that delta rho exceeds 0.10.

taxonomy.both_operator_increments_supported: both cells satisfy the frozen support rule; both proposed explanations remain consistent with the observations
taxonomy.clamp_increment_supported_complement_unr: the clamp cell satisfies the frozen support rule and the complement cell does not; this does not establish that complement-mediated influence is absent
taxonomy.complement_increment_supported_clamp_unr: the complement cell satisfies the frozen support rule and the clamp cell does not; this does not establish that clamp-sensitive downstream influence is absent
taxonomy.no_operator_increment_resolved: neither cell satisfies the frozen support rule; this is unresolved rather than evidence that both mechanisms are absent

complement_once.purpose: test whether donor-consistent visual influence is available outside the original full-frame visual-token span
complement_once.semantics: At post-block L, replace every active sequence position except the full-frame image-token positions with the corresponding native donor state. Padding is excluded. The full-frame positions remain recipient-derived.

full_sequence_once.inferential_role: architecture-predicted positive contract control, excluded from the four-cell mechanism family
full_sequence_once.purpose: verify that the complete donor residual state at L deterministically closes the measured answer margin
full_sequence_once.semantics: At post-block L, replace every active non-padding sequence position with the corresponding native donor state.

persistent_full_frame.inferential_limit: An increment over a one-shot patch is consistent with downstream recontamination, but it can also arise because later native donor states repeatedly reintroduce donor information. The operator does not identify those explanations separately.
persistent_full_frame.purpose: test whether repeated native-donor full-frame replacement improves donor consistency beyond a one-time full-frame transplant
persistent_full_frame.semantics: Starting at post-block L and continuing through the architecture-specific final post-block, replace the complete full-frame visual-token span after every block with that block's state captured from one native, unpatched donor forward. Donor states are never recursively generated from a hybrid run.

single_full_frame.purpose: exact replication anchor for the source depth profile
single_full_frame.semantics: At post-block L only, replace the complete full-frame visual-token span with the corresponding native donor state.

outcome.statistical_unit: participant cluster after averaging its two counterbalanced orders

primary_estimands.conditions: equal weight over the two central depths, two corruptions, and two directions within each participant cluster

statistics.interval: participant-cluster percentile bootstrap 95 percent descriptive interval

technical_gates.complement_partition: selected complement and preserved full-frame sets must be disjoint and partition all active positions
technical_gates.gpu_memory: each model/operator canary must remain below 76 GiB peak CUDA allocation on an 80 GiB H100
technical_gates.hook_contract: every expected hook fires exactly once, changes only its selected positions, receives shape-compatible finite donor state, and is removed
technical_gates.model_cache: exact pinned offline revisions and weight files must exist before workers launch
technical_gates.self_patch: canary self-patches for every operator must preserve the native answer margin within 0.001 bits
